outcome: HPV positivity in newborn samples (eye, pharyngeal, mouth, genital)
cohort: Pregnant women referred to the obstetric outpatient room of the Department of Gynecology and Obstetrics of Sant'Anna and San Sebastiano University Hospital in Caserta, Italy.
finding: The study found a high prevalence of HPV infections in recruited pregnant patients (45%), with 14% showing positivity in placental samples, but a low prevalence of viral infection in newborns (9% at birth).
